obligations: all application routes deny unauthenticated access
operator, viewer, and admin roles retain least-privilege route access
CSRF exclusion is limited to the exact stateless order creation route
credentials have no application default and are encoded before use
health is public, metrics is administrator-only, and health details stay hidden
PostgreSQL 17.5 schema constraints preserve positive money and nonnegative inventory
request identity and message identity remain unique
JPA schema validation runs at startup
order and outbox writes commit atomically
a failure after outbox creation rolls both records back
concurrent inventory reservation uses a database pessimistic write lock
RabbitMQ exchange and queue are durable
outbox records are marked published only after broker confirmation
duplicate at-least-once deliveries are consumed once through the PostgreSQL ledger
